'''Caledra Dawnbreeze''' is a former Ranger-Captain of the [[Farstriders]] who fought throughout the [[Second War]]. After the fall of [[Quel'Thalas]] she became a citizen of [[Stormwind City]] and resides in the [[Petitioner's Chamber]] in [[Stormwind Keep]]. In an attempt to find a way to restore her people, she managed to gather high elven representatives from outlying settlements for a meeting that leads to the re-discovery of Alah'Thalas and rallying Silvermoon Remnants around its banner.<ref name="Assisting the Children of the Sun" />
